p: Premium Framer Template for Homestays, Vacation Rentals & Real Estate

Northway is a premium Framer template built for homestays, vacation rentals, hotels, villas, resorts, real estate, and tourism businesses. Featuring immersive visuals, smooth animations, interactive galleries, booking-focused layouts, and premium user interactions, it helps you showcase properties beautifully while increasing enquiries and reservations. Fully responsive, lightning-fast, and easy to customise without sacrificing performance.

Many property and hospitality websites feel outdated, overloaded with information, and fail to create an emotional connection with potential guests. Generic layouts and static presentations make it difficult to showcase the unique experience of staying at a property, leading to lower engagement and fewer booking enquiries.

This template was created to solve that by combining premium visuals, smooth interactions, immersive galleries, and conversion-focused layouts that help businesses build trust, highlight their properties, and turn visitors into confirmed bookings.
